title: Return policy / 退貨政策
text_en: Items can be returned within 14 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Refunds are reviewed by our team after the returned item is inspected.
text_zh: 商品於到貨後 14 天內、未使用且包裝完整，可申請退貨。退款需待我們收到並檢查退回商品後，由客服人員審核。

title: Defective or wrong item / 瑕疵或寄錯商品
text_en: If an item arrives damaged, defective, or is not what you ordered, please send your order number and a photo. We will arrange a replacement or return review.
text_zh: 若商品損壞、有瑕疵或與訂購內容不符，請提供訂單編號與照片，我們會安排換貨或退貨審核。

title: Delivery times / 配送時程
text_en: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. You can track your parcel with the tracking number in your dispatch email.
text_zh: 標準配送於出貨後約 3 至 5 個工作天送達，您可使用出貨通知信中的追蹤編號查詢包裹。

title: Delayed parcels / 包裹延遲
text_en: If your parcel has not arrived after 7 business days, please send your order number so we can open a carrier investigation.
text_zh: 若包裹超過 7 個工作天仍未送達，請提供訂單編號，我們會向物流業者發起查詢。

title: Invoices and receipts / 發票與收據
text_en: Invoices are issued after payment is confirmed. To add a company tax ID, please send your order number and the tax ID; changes after issuance require a reissue request.
text_zh: 發票於付款確認後開立。如需加註統一編號，請提供訂單編號與統編；開立後如需更改須申請重開。

title: Duplicate charges / 重複扣款
text_en: If you see two charges for one order, a pending authorization may be showing. If it remains after 3 business days, send your order number and the last 4 digits of the card only.
text_zh: 若同一筆訂單看到兩筆扣款，可能是尚未釋放的預授權。若 3 個工作天後仍存在，請提供訂單編號與卡號末 4 碼（請勿提供完整卡號）。

title: Password reset / 重設密碼
text_en: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page to receive a reset email. Never send your password to support; we will never ask for it.
text_zh: 請使用登入頁的「忘記密碼」連結以收取重設信。請勿將密碼寄給客服，我們不會向您索取密碼。

title: Locked account / 帳號鎖定
text_en: Accounts are locked for 30 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts. If the lock persists, our team can verify your identity through the registered email.
text_zh: 連續登入失敗 5 次會鎖定帳號 30 分鐘。若仍無法解鎖，客服人員可透過註冊信箱協助驗證身分。

title: Warranty / 保固
text_en: Products carry a 12-month limited warranty covering manufacturing defects from the date of delivery.
text_zh: 商品提供自到貨日起 12 個月有限保固，涵蓋製造瑕疵。

title: Compatibility / 相容性
text_en: Compatibility information is listed on each product page under Specifications. If your device is not listed, please tell us the exact model and we will check with the product team.
text_zh: 相容性資訊列於各商品頁的「規格」。若您的裝置未列出，請告知確切型號，我們將向產品團隊確認。
